verdict.rationale: The evidence shows nearby controls but no gate that pauses sensitive actions for operator approval. Approval and Touch ID apply to vault items and credential access, 'Set permissions' controls what the agent may do in advance, and operators can manually step in or pause and resume. None of these is a documented pre-execution approval for payments, sends or deletes. missing for 10: documented action-level approval gates that pause the agent before sensitive actions (payments, sends, deletes) execute, plus hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operator, sensitive actions (payments, sends, deletes) pause for my approval before the agent executes them
